aiReadyLines.text: Unit Seven : Games and Sports 79
Do men and women in our country enjoy any of these games or sports?
Do you enjoy any of these or other games and sports? Which one/s?
Which of the above sports are commonly practised by women in your
locality? Which ones are practised by men?
Work in pairs. Which of these activities are popular with the following
age groups? Tick the activities. Then compare with your partner
and make sentences.
(There can be more than one activity for each group.)
children | teens | young middle-aged | older
adults people people
A: I think is popular with teens.
B: And with young adults too.
Pairwork. Take turns asking the questions in part A of the above
exercise. Give your own information while answering.
l hardly ‘ever go for a walk in the ‘morning.
1 ‘often go ‘swimming on ‘Fridays.
1 ‘seldom do ‘yoga.
E. Work in pairs. Take turns to say about your exercise habits using a word
given in Section D.
